results.reader_more: On 30 July 2026 the European Commission invited bids to build up to seven AI 'gigafactories' — very large data centres for training and running advanced AI models. Funding runs through the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking, and 18 countries have signed a joint procurement agreement.
